MASTER COURT CALENDAR SET FOR MAY-23-2022 - JONATHAN VAKNIN, ESQ. SPECIALLY APPEARING IN PERSON FOR BRYANT BURNSTAD, ESQ., ATTORNEY OF RECORD FOR PLAINTIFF AUTOVEST LLC. DEFENDANT CLAUDIA MARIA CASOVERDE DIAZ, SELF-REPRESENTED LITIGANT, APPEARING IN PERSON. MONICA HERNANDEZ, COURT CERTIFIED SPANISH INTERPRETER, WITH OATH ON FILE, PRESENT AND ASSISTED DEFENDANT. THE COURT CONTINUED THE TRIAL DATE TO JUL-06-2022 AT 9:30AM IN DEPT. 206 FOR PARTIES TO FINALIZE SETTLEMENT/SETTLEMENT PROTECTIVE DATE. THE COURT SETS ORDERS TO SHOW CAUSE ISSUED TO ATTY. BRYANT BURNSTAD (COUNSEL OF RECORD FOR PLAINTIFF) AND DEFENDANT CLAUDIA MARIA CASOVERDE DIAZ FOR JUL-06-2022 IN DEPARTMENT 206 AT 9:30 AM TO SHOW CAUSE WHY SANCTIONS, IN THE AMOUNT OF $250.00 EACH, SHOULD NOT BE IMPOSED FOR FAILURE TO COMPLY WITH THE COURT'S ORDER PURSUANT TO THE NOTICE OF TIME AND PLACE OF TRIAL AND TRIAL ORDER. NOTICE SENT BY COURT. COURT ORDERED PARTIES TO COMPLY WITH SAID NOTICE OF TIME AND PLACE OF TRIAL AND TRIAL ORDER (REFER TO 12/27/21 NOTICE OF TIME & PLACE OF TRIAL IN COURT'S REGISTER OF ACTIONS) FOR THE NEW TRIAL DATE OF 07/06/22 WHEREIN PARTIES TO NOTIFY THE COURT 7-14 DAYS BEFORE THE TRIAL DATE AND PROVIDE INFORMATION RE STATUS OF THE CASE. IF THE CASE SETTLES, PARTIES DO NOT NEED TO APPEAR AND THE COURT WILL VACATE ALL SANCTIONS AND THE OSC. IF THE CASE DOES NOT SETTLE, THE COURT WILL ASSIGN THE CASE OUT TO TRIAL, BOTH SIDES TO PAY SANCTIONS IN THE AMOUNT OF $250.00 EACH AND THE OSC WILL BE SET FOR 07/06/22. THE COURT ORDERED PLAINTIFF'S COUNSEL AND SELF-REPRESENTED DEFENDANT TO APPEAR IN PERSON IF THE CASE DOES NOT SETTLE. PLAINTIFF'S CLIENT MAY APPEAR VIRTUALLY. PLAINTIFF TO GIVE NOTICE OF THE NEW TRIAL DATE. JUDGE: SAMUEL K. FENG; MATTER NOT REPORTED (206)
